description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The April 2022 campaign records LTE in-phase and quadrature samples at UAV heights of 30, 50, 70, 90 and 110 metres at Lake Wheeler. A ground srsRAN LTE base station and a UAV-mounted software-defined radio provide the air-to-ground measurements. GPS logs accompany the SigMF recordings. The landing description specifies 3.5 GHz. The provider identifies propagation modelling, receiver processing and channel estimation as uses. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. Access links are supplied on the provider landing page. Licence, cost and access requirements remain uncertain for the linked release. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Air-to-ground LTE propagation and receiver modelling. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
